title: Account
description: A principal the solution can authenticate — a person, a service, or a tenant-bound operator.

handle.description: The login identifier the principal types. Usually an email address; never assumed to be one.

display-name.description: Shown to other humans. Carries no authorization meaning.

principal-type.description: Whether a human or a machine holds this account. Governs which credential methods are legal.

status.description: "locked" is automatic and temporary; "disabled" is a decision by a human.

tenant-id.description: Tenant the account belongs to. Absent for a solution-wide principal.

roles.description: Roles assigned to this account, by id. Never embedded — an account must not go stale when a role changes.

multi-factor-enrolled.description: Whether a second factor is registered. A permission requiring one is denied when this is false.

erased-at.description: When the erasure obligation was discharged. Set together with status "erased".
